_comment: Site-wide announcement bar (every page) and homepage news card (/ and /ar/). Owner SEO brief 21 Nov 2026: show from publication until 15 January 2027, then remove. The bar and card hide themselves in the browser after `until` (assets/js/oet-announce.js + the head script in layouts/Base.astro), so the static HTML never depends on the build date. To remove them for good: delete this file, src/components/Announcement.astro, src/lib/announce.mjs, the <!--oet:news-card--> markers in partials/index/main.html and partials/ar/main.html, and the Announcement lines in layouts/Base.astro; then rebuild.
